brief.t: START HERE: Walk to Ron and Aaron and ask for today's Mothered separation and viscosity results before anyone scales up.

ACT NOW 1: Mothered quality gate is due today. Michael's October 22 update says Ron and Aaron are resolving separation and viscosity, with scale-up conditional on satisfactory results October 23. This is a 1-day-old update, not an overdue test deadline. Send: Ron and Aaron, please show me today's Mothered results and confirm the acceptance criteria, QC checks and documented procedure before we agree a scale up time.

ACT NOW 2: TALOVA needs both material clarification and shipment reconciliation. Michael reported ingredients not meeting expectations yesterday; Marcello has waited 3 calendar days since October 20 for tight-window FBA labels and shipments showing unshipped. Send: Aaron, please identify the TALOVA ingredient concerns and affected batches today so I can reconcile usable inventory and give Marcello verified shipment dates and tracking.

ACT NOW 3: Get Polo's rail appointment for EMCU8614105. Sasha's October 22 update says pending ingate because the rail yard has no available appointments; this status is 1 day old, with no promised ingate date. Do not assume it is still at the exam site or pay the exam invoice twice. Send: Sasha, please confirm the first available rail appointment, current container location and any charges accruing today, and have Erik confirm whether any payment or release conditions remain open.

next: Recommendation: Clear the Mothered quality gate first, then reconcile TALOVA quality and fulfillment, then obtain Polo's rail appointment.

Displaced: The earlier ingredient-approval bundle leaves the top three because yesterday's direct lab update establishes a current Mothered quality gate; the older Agua, Silgreen and Magnolia closure statuses remain unverified, not resolved.

Scheduled: 17 active CRM task records, including 16 with displayed dates before today; these are records requiring reconciliation, not 16 independently verified unfinished jobs. Nearest displayed due date is October 22 for Ashley's technical feasibility input to Sam. Customer pricing remains with Sam. Yesterday's Hassell count update reports a response sent although its CRM task remains active.
